hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); deny() { printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$1"; exit 0; }; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'gh pr merge|pulls/[0-9]+/merge|gh pr review[^|;&]*--approve|gh api[^|;&]*(-X|--method|--input|-f |-F )[^|;&]*protection|gh api[^|;&]*protection[^|;&]*(-X|--method|--input|-f |-F )|gh ruleset|gh repo delete|gh repo edit' && deny "The owner reviews and merges PRs on GitHub. Never merge, approve, or change branch protection from this session."; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git push[^|;&]*( main( |$)| HEAD:main( |$)|:main( |$)|--force|-f( |$)| \+)' && deny "Never push to main or force push. Open a PR from a branch instead."; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'cargo mutants|cargo-mutants +(-|mutants)' && deny "Raw cargo-mutants once crashed the laptop. Run cargo xtask mutants, which locks, caps jobs, and checks free memory."; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'gh pr (create|edit)[^|;&]*(--base|-B)[ =]+' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'gh pr (create|edit)[^|;&]*(--base|-B)[ =]+main( |$)' && deny "A PR whose base is not main is part of a stack. Link it with gh stack link <bottom> ... <top> or gh stack submit, never gh pr create --base."; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking merge, mutants, and stack guards
